explication: IMSI-catcher receives GSMTAP traffic decoded by gr-gsm, extracts cell and mobile identities, enriches IMSIs with country/operator data, and displays or saves observations. Its principal workflow is documented in the README; the sampled source confirms identity parsing, tracking, and SQLite/TXT/MySQL persistence. The same program also offers packet sniffing and an immediate-assignment inspection utility. Some runtime wiring is not shown in the excerpts, so only documented or excerpt-supported relationships are drawn.
